title: Island 3: Particles (に / で)
idea: A forest island where the player learns the particles に and で by catching the wood piece with the right particle for a sentence Ryuuko shows, and keeps the supplies they earn.

glossary.meaning: A small Japanese word after a noun that marks its role in the sentence; island 3 teaches に and で.
A box at the top of the screen showing the current sentence with one blank where the particle goes.
A block Ryuuko throws, labelled with one particle; catching it is the player's answer.
What the player keeps when they catch the right wood piece (food, wood, other supplies).
A wood piece with a particle that is never the answer on island 3 (を or へ); thrown only in level 2.
A +1 count in the quest HUD with a small supply icon (wood, apple, mushroom...) for each right catch. Not saved after the quest.
A short beginner sentence in hiragana with one blank for the particle, shown with its English meaning under it (e.g. がっこう＿いく / I go to school).

features.name: Forest island scene
features.whatItDoes: Island 3's map: a forest with lots of trees, built with /make-scene.
details: Same island NPCs as the other islands; their quest offer opens the particle quest
Sections top to bottom: deep forest (y 0-800, #7fae5a), clearing (y 800-1600, #a9cf7a, spawn), bank (y 1600-1700, sand #f3e9c6), river (y 1700-2000, #87ceeb, solid)
Deep forest: き tree (reuse), まつ pine tree, きりかぶ stump
Clearing: いえ cabin, まき woodpile, りんごのき apple tree, おの axe
Bank / river: はし bridge, いわ rock (reuse), さかな fish, ふね boat
Ground plants reuse fern / grass-tuft / clover / small-bush (forest, clearing) and pebbles / driftwood (bank)
Full tables in docs/scenes/forest-island.md

features.name: Particle quest (catch the right wood)
features.whatItDoes: A copy of the catch quest: the sentence sign shows a sentence with a blank, Ryuuko throws wood pieces labelled with particles, the right catch keeps the supply, a wrong catch costs HP.
details: Quest type 'particle'; islandQuestType(3) returns 'particle'
Hiroko explains it first, like the other quest types
The answer is always に or で; level 2 also throws を and へ as decoys
Shaped like the catch quest: level 1 and level 2, 60 s each, 10 HP, quota 10 sentences per level
Each right catch moves the sign to the next sentence and adds +1 to the supply counter
Level 1 throws only the two choices に / で, slowly; level 2 throws faster and adds the decoys
A wrong catch costs 1 HP and the same sentence stays
The sign shows the sentence in hiragana with ＿ for the blank, and its English under it; no kanji, no romaji
A right catch plays Ryuuko reading the whole sentence with the right particle (one mp3 per sentence)
A wrong catch plays the damage sound and Ryuuko says the particle that was caught

features.name: Island 3 quests
features.whatItDoes: Three quests on island 3: に sentences, で sentences, then a mix of both.
details: Quest 1: に only (place of existence, time, destination)
Quest 2: で only (place of an action)
Quest 3: に and で mixed
One NPC at a time offers a quest, like the kana rows: に first, then で once に is cleared, then the mix
The other NPCs just talk
Claude drafts 12 sentences for に and 12 for で (the mix draws from both); the user edits and adds more later

flows.name: Play the に quest
steps: On island 3, the NPC offering the に quest says 「に」のクエスト and asks はい / いいえ
はい opens the particle quest; Hiroko offers the tutorial the first time
Talking to Ryuuko starts level 1: the sign shows a sentence with a blank and its English
Ryuuko throws wood pieces labelled に and で; the player catches one
Right: Ryuuko reads the full sentence, supply counter +1, the next sentence shows
Wrong: damage sound, Ryuuko says the caught particle, -1 HP, same sentence
After 10 right catches, Ryuuko offers level 2 (faster, を / へ decoys added)
Clearing level 2 ends the quest (COMPLETE); running out of HP or time shows Elena and Ryuuko's retry offer

examples.situation: Sign: がっこう＿いく / I go to school. The player catches で.
examples.whatHappens: Wrong: -1 HP, damage sound, Ryuuko says で, the same sentence stays.

examples.situation: Sign: こうえん＿あそぶ / I play in the park. The player catches で.
examples.whatHappens: Right: Ryuuko says こうえんであそぶ, supply counter +1, the next sentence shows.

examples.situation: Level 2 of the mix quest: an を piece flies past.
examples.whatHappens: It is a decoy; catching it costs 1 HP. Dodging it costs nothing.

leftOut: Saving supplies or a boat inventory
Kanji or furigana on the sign
Particles other than に / で as answers
Sentence editing UI (the user edits particles.ts directly)

decisions.decision: Island 3 follows ikko-vision.pdf (particles に / で, tree-heavy island) rather than docs/curriculum.md's airport unit.
The quest is 'catch the right wood', reusing the catch quest (training.ts / questIsland.tsx) plus a sentence sign like the door quest's.
Answers are に or で only; を and へ are level-2 decoys.
Three quests: に, で, mix.
Run shape copies the catch quest: 2 levels, 60 s, 10 HP, 10 sentences per level.
Supplies are a HUD counter only, nothing saved.
Sentence sign: hiragana with a blank plus English; no kanji or romaji.
Right catch plays the full sentence; wrong catch plays damage + the caught particle.
Quests unlock one at a time (に -> で -> mix), each offered by one NPC.
Scene: deep forest / clearing / bank / river, 9 new props (pine-tree, stump, cabin, woodpile, apple-tree, axe, bridge, fish, boat) plus reused tree and rock.

assumptions.statement: "Generate 12" means 12 sentences per particle (に and で), so each 10-sentence level has variety; the mix quest draws from both lists.
